subject.title: Gateway becomes slow or times out under multi-session / multi-agent load

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for live Gateway multi-session liveness, or should maintainers split it into narrower handler/storage issues now?
rationale: Source and history show several shipped partial mitigations, but only a maintainer can decide whether the remaining evidence is enough to keep one broad live-repro blocker versus carving out narrower work before a fresh replay.

options.title: Keep canonical live-repro tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open, require a current-main or v2026.6.11 live replay, and split only confirmed remaining bottlenecks after the replay.

options.title: Split now by handler
options.body: Open narrower follow-ups for sessions.compact, chat.history, logs.tail, and event-loop starvation based on existing evidence, then use this issue only as an umbrella.

options.title: Close after release replay
options.body: Close only if a current-release replay of the reported large multi-session workload shows Gateway RPC, WebSocket, and queued message handling remain responsive.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical live-repro tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, require a current-main or v2026.6.11 live replay, and split only confirmed remaining bottlenecks after the replay.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the broadest owner candidate from the live issue discussion and adjacent Gateway/session performance area rather than one of the narrower already-merged fix slices.
